design: Exploratory analysis plan recorded after inspecting schema and previously published summaries, before executing new expansion calculations; not preregistered.
unit: Indexed upload, publishing account, title text, retained caption derivative; none is a confirmed individual medium or entity voice.

hypotheses.question: Is the purposive caption pilot skewed toward longer indexed uploads?
hypotheses.test: Compare known-duration empirical median and IQR, overall and within matched publishing accounts.
hypotheses.falsifier: Pilot median is no larger than the comparator median; descriptive sample difference only.

hypotheses.question: Does a small set of publishing accounts dominate the indexed uploads?
hypotheses.test: Top-k cumulative shares, Gini and HHI among account groups with uploads; unresolved account association shown separately.
hypotheses.falsifier: Top ten account groups contain no more than half of attributed uploads. Threshold is an exploration aid, not a general concentration standard.

hypotheses.question: Do title keyword indicators differ across upload-duration bands?
hypotheses.test: Nine transparent overlapping regex indicators across five duration bands among English-likely eligible titles; per-account long-versus-short contrasts where at least 3 titles in each stratum.
hypotheses.falsifier: The paired per-account median difference for each indicator is zero or opposite in direction to the pooled long-minus-short difference. This does not confirm a format mechanism.

hypotheses.question: Is same-publisher caption similarity above different-publisher similarity on this pilot, and how does matched title similarity compare?
hypotheses.test: Pairwise cosine mean difference on identical title/caption upload IDs; 2000 seeded publisher-label permutations preserve group sizes and act as a descriptive negative control; no independent-pair confidence interval or population p-value.
hypotheses.falsifier: Observed difference is no larger than the median shuffled-label difference; nearest-neighbor attribution and semantic validity remain untested.

hypotheses.question: How much exact title repetition is present?
hypotheses.test: NFKD/casefold punctuation-normalized title families with and without the documented name-and-genre mask; compare published masked-title deduplication sensitivity.
hypotheses.falsifier: No repeated normalized strings. Shared title text is not proof of the same original recording.

boundaries: No newly retrieved video/caption material is claimed by these frozen-snapshot calculations.
No entity-origin, truth, clinical, causal, global prevalence or answer-agreement inference.
Keyword categories overlap and are unvalidated; titles are packaging, not full content.
Language eligibility is inherited heuristic output.
Permutation labels intentionally destroy real publisher association; exchangeability is hypothetical, so the reference distribution is diagnostic only.
